_README: mm-rescaled twin of office_room_material_map.json (W2.10 / ADR-0002). Same physical room, vertices x1000, units:'mm'. Every check_geometry tolerance is absolute METRES, so `units` is load-bearing: this file must report ok:true with the SAME findings as the metre model. Regression it guards: units/up_axis were resolved from the sidecar and then never passed on, so a 1x1 m end-cap read as 1e6 units^2 and raised a spurious COINCIDENT_SURFACES error.
